description:
1. Agent reads task_brief.json and extracts the idea: 'a CLI tool that automatically generates OpenAPI specifications from existing Python codebase comments and type hints'. It also notes the keyword 'Deep check:' at the start of the idea field and the phrase 'thorough scan' in context, both of which signal depth=deep per SKILL.md rules.
2. Agent registers the idea-reality MCP server in mcporter using the exact command from SKILL.md Prerequisites: `mcporter config add idea-reality --command "uvx idea-reality-mcp"`.
3. Agent calls `mcporter call idea-reality.idea_check idea_text="<extracted idea>" depth=deep` — using the correct dot-notation tool reference `idea-reality.idea_check` and `depth=deep` (not `quick`).
4. The mock returns reality_signal=87, sources=[GitHub, HN, npm, PyPI, Product Hunt], top_similars=[flasgger/3400★, spectree/1200★, apispec/1100★], and pivot hints.
5. Agent applies the >70 threshold rule: uses a RED emoji, shows signal 87/100 in the header format `<emoji> Idea Check — 87/100`, lists all 3 competitors with star counts, and STOPS to ask the user whether to proceed, pivot, or abandon.
6. Agent also includes pivot hints (since signal > 30) and lists all 5 sources checked.
7. Saves the full formatted report to `idea_check_result.md` in the workspace.
